capabilities: look up English words and sentences
import vocabulary from CSV and Markdown files
track word mastery and back up learning data
extras: Closed-source proprietary software; freemium split between a free Community edition and a paid Pro upgrade. AI and user-configured online dictionary or pronunciation requests send the queried word or context to external services. Mobile backups use device-local storage and may be cleared by the system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in English dictionary lookup or vocabulary-learning workflow for readers who want to save and review words they encounter.

relations.evidence: InkLex Free includes lexical evidence derived from Open English WordNet 2025, which is based on Princeton WordNet

summary: English vocabulary tool that looks up words, highlights vocabulary in notes, builds word cards, and tracks learning progress.
